make benchmark corpus generation/replay deterministic: stable case ids/order, stable expected facts/assertions, no machine-specific absolute paths, no network dependency for corpus construction, and no secrets/private metadata in JSONL or generated reports

layered evidence reuse matrix: for OCR, document, UI, code, chart, screenshot, translation, and compare tasks, ask two materially different questions about the same image set; prove the second call uses route.source=evidence-cache with zero provider calls only when the first broad reusable evidence actually contains enough facts to answer

narrow-refocus matrix: after broad reusable evidence, ask deliberately narrow questions for details absent from that evidence; prove the system does not guess, issues a focused fresh cache=no-store visual call when needed, and preserves the broader reusable evidence afterward instead of replacing it with the narrow read

ordinary photo/general behavior: prove question-specific photo/general requests do not become incorrectly answerable from broad layered evidence when the cache policy says they should remain fresh/question-specific
explicit provider/model behavior: prove explicit provider or model requests bypass layered reusable evidence and reach the selected backend while retaining Batch 014 no-reroute/stickiness semantics

cache=no-store behavior: prove it bypasses both layered reusable evidence and adapter semantic cache, produces fresh provider traffic, and does not write the focused result into reusable evidence unless the existing documented policy explicitly says otherwise

cache=refresh behavior: prove it bypasses stale reusable/semantic evidence, performs a fresh pixel analysis, and replaces the appropriate reusable evidence with the fresh broad result when policy permits

settings/provider/model invalidation: change active provider/model or other cache-key-affecting settings in task-owned configuration after an evidence hit and prove reusable evidence is invalidated immediately and no cross-configuration stale answer is returned

semantic-cache vs evidence-cache truthfulness: for identical-request semantic reuse and broader layered-evidence reuse, reconcile route.source, route.task, route.cacheMode, route.evidenceLayerEnabled, providerCalls, cacheHits, retries, modelFallbacks, providerFallbacks, selectedProvider/model, and observed deterministic traffic; semantic/evidence cache hits must not create synthetic provider-health successes

routeSourceOutcomes audit: run benchmark scoring on the frozen corpus/results and independently count raw JSONL route.source + outcome pairs; prove scoreBenchmark routeSourceOutcomes and route/trace/token coverage match the raw records exactly, and missing telemetry is reported as missing coverage rather than zero cost

baseline-vs-candidate cost/quality run: use the same frozen corpus and comparable provider/settings to compare a forced-fresh or semantic-cache-only baseline against the layered-evidence candidate; record provider calls, payload bytes, input/output tokens when disclosed, latency, routing/task success, forbidden hits, route/trace/token coverage, and zero-provider reuse; use scripts/vision-benchmark-compare.mjs DEFAULT_BENCHMARK_THRESHOLDS as the minimum acceptance gate and do not loosen them to force a pass

quality assertions on deterministic corpus: score exact expected facts/OCR strings/task assertions for baseline and candidate so cost savings cannot pass solely because routing succeeded; if existing scorer lacks an auditable quality dimension needed for these cases, extend benchmark schema/scorer/tests conservatively and keep backward compatibility with existing example data

long screenshot preprocessing: generate or use deterministic text-heavy PNG cases at 1440x10000 and at least one substantially taller case around 1440x20000; prove preprocessing stays within intended pixel/byte/provider payload bounds, preserves ordering/layout metadata, and does not collapse horizontal text into unreadable geometry

preprocessing comparison: compare current aspect/pixel-aware PNG preprocessing against the historical 3072-long-edge behavior or a faithful benchmark-only baseline on the same long-page fixtures; record output dimensions/bytes/latency and quality assertions, and retain current behavior only if it is at least as good under the repository benchmark gate without unacceptable memory/latency regression

recursive split/image numbering regression: include multi-image and oversized cases that exercise split/merge where relevant and prove final answers/evidence retain original Image N numbering, trace splits/providerCalls/payloadBytes remain truthful, and reusable evidence never mixes image order across batches

visual provider quality when explicitly available: if the task environment already exposes an authorized local vision model or hosted-provider credential through an explicit task/runtime seam, run the minimum representative subset needed to compare forced-fresh vs layered evidence on OCR/UI/document/chart/long-screenshot quality and cost; never read real Harness settings to discover credentials, and if none is authorized mark this subcheck SKIP/PARTIAL rather than fabricating provider-quality evidence

optimization rule: if any cache/preprocessing optimization saves calls/tokens/latency but violates benchmark:compare thresholds, increases forbidden hits, materially reduces deterministic expected-fact/OCR/task quality, guesses on narrow follow-ups, or makes telemetry less truthful, fix/revert/redesign it inside this same batch before completion

acceptance_criteria: Task Contract validates before execution; exact source SHA, task branch, and Draft PR are recorded, and all implementation/test/benchmark changes are Codex-owned.

The frozen benchmark corpus/manifest is deterministic, repository-safe, reproducible offline, and covers the planned 20 UI + 20 IDE/terminal + 20 document/OCR + 15 chart + 15 photo/general + 10 compare/diff case mix or documents an equivalent 100-case mapping with the same category totals.

Layered evidence reuse occurs only when broad evidence is sufficient; narrow missing-detail follow-ups trigger a fresh focused no-store read rather than guessing, and focused reads do not destroy broader reusable evidence.

cache=no-store bypasses both layered and semantic caches; cache=refresh performs fresh analysis and refreshes reusable evidence according to policy; explicit provider/model and cache-key-affecting setting changes do not reuse stale evidence.
Provider, semantic-cache, and evidence-cache routes remain distinguishable and truthful against observed traffic, trace, usage, route decision fields, and provider-health accounting.
Benchmark routeSourceOutcomes plus route/trace/token coverage reconcile exactly with raw JSONL; unavailable telemetry is missing coverage, never silently treated as zero cost.

Baseline-vs-candidate comparison uses the same frozen corpus/provider/settings and passes the existing DEFAULT_BENCHMARK_THRESHOLDS without threshold loosening; a controlled regression still causes a non-zero compare result.
Deterministic expected-fact/OCR/task assertions show no unacceptable quality regression from layered evidence reuse; cost/latency wins do not override correctness failures.

Long 1440x10000 and substantially taller PNG preprocessing remains within intended resource bounds and preserves readable/order-sensitive visual structure under deterministic quality assertions; comparison against the historical long-edge baseline does not justify a regression.
Multi-image/split results retain original Image N numbering and truthful split/provider-call/payload/usage accounting.

Any explicitly available real/local visual-provider quality evidence is minimal, secret-safe, and clearly separated from deterministic evidence; lack of authorized provider credentials never permits reading real Harness settings and is reported honestly rather than blocking product-code correctness claims.
All focused tests, full repository/package/built lanes, benchmark score/compare gates, final task-branch CI, and secret-scan pass after any fixes.

Result Contract v2 uses second-precision timezone-aware timestamps, truthful PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL/SKIP states, validator-owned --stamp evidence, and explicitly lists any external provider-quality limitation that remains.

On completion delete docs/agent-tasks/ACTIVE_TASK.json on the execution branch, commit/push implementation/tests/benchmark assets/Result plus ACTIVE task deletion, leave the Draft PR unmerged, and stop without self-assigning Batch 016.
